cases.input: Render an approved learning-content model as editable DOCX and derived PDF under the active DESIGN.md, preserving claims, timestamps and visual provenance.
requiredBehaviors: keep DOCX as the canonical layout source and derive PDF from it
preserve claim confidence evidence classes numbers warnings and source references
perform complete page-by-page DOCX and PDF QA
forbiddenBehaviors: silently claim corporate approval or fallback status

cases.input: A corporate context exists but no confirmed corporate DOCX renderer/template can be safely applied; a neutral fallback would violate the requested brand authority.
requiredBehaviors: avoid silent fallback when a corporate gate is required
surface the missing renderer/template authority as a delivery limitation
forbiddenBehaviors: label a neutral document as corporate-approved

cases.input: The renderer changes a parameter to shorten a table, creates DOCX and PDF independently and reports parity without page rendering.
requiredBehaviors: reject fachliche value changes for layout
reject independent DOCX and PDF authoring
reject parity claims without actual page render
forbiddenBehaviors: solve layout by altering claims or data
skillAnchors: DOCX und PDF werden nicht unabhängig neu geschrieben
